title: Report of the fixer for one key and one pass of the fix mode
description: Content of fix/<repo>/<slug>/report-<N>.json, checked by cqa_fix.py validate <run_dir> <key> report --pass <N> (exit 6 with the list of errors). One row per row of the dispatch; every row still pending in the state must be there. Texts a reviewer or a lead dev reads (change, uat, reason, question, attention) are written in French. A valid report updates the rows of fix/state.json.

key.description: Key <repo>/<slug>, as in the Fix: field of the dispatch.

pass.description: Number of the pass, as in the Pass: field of the dispatch.

rows.description: One entry per row. A ref that is not a row of the key, or that appears twice, is rejected.

ref.description: Ref of the checklist row, as an integer (107 for CQ-107).

outcome.description: fixed: corrected by commits of the branch (a row given up after its commits stays fixed, with an attention starting with « Abandon : »). skipped: not attempted, with the reason; no commit of the row on the branch. question: a decision is missing, the row waits for the answer; no commit of the row on the branch.

change.description: Required for fixed: what changed, in French, 1 to 600 characters.

uat.description: Required for fixed: the manual acceptance test a reviewer runs, in French, 1 to 600 characters.

commits.description: Required for fixed, at least one: SHAs (full or abbreviated) of commits of <start_sha>..HEAD whose subject carries the ref of the row, or the covered_by ref.

reason.description: Required for skipped: why, in French, 1 to 300 characters (for example: déjà corrigé sur develop).

covered_by.description: fixed only: the ref of another row of the key whose commit also fixes this row (a commit carries one row only).

attention.description: Optional: what the reviewer should look at closely, in French (for a Semi-auto row, the À valider of the finding).

text.description: The question for the lead, in French. Its text is kept as the reason of the row in the state.

options.description: The possible answers, in French, 2 to 4.

default.description: What the fixer would do without an answer: one of the options.

rows.change: Ajoute les en-têtes de sécurité dans la configuration du serveur web du thème.
rows.uat: Ouvrir la page d'accueil et vérifier l'en-tête X-Content-Type-Options dans les outils du navigateur.
